title: FIrst Rate experience
text: VIP Malaga Tours is a first rate travel service that I highly recommend.   Everything from the planning with Mark to the van driver Pepe to the Alhambra guide Simon was excellent.   The van is a little crowded for 8 people but the tour and the service more that made up for the discomfort.   You will not be disappointed.
author: stanc700

title: Excellent service and wonderful tours!
text:
My group of 7 enjoyed two fabulous tours with VIP Malaga Tours!  These were over two years in the making as covid stood in the way.  We were originally going to take the Tangiers day trip, but due to high winds, ferry service was canceled.  As disappointed as we were,  Mark was quick to offer other wonderful suggestions and we opted for Gibraltar!  It was a fabulous tour and we enjoyed an exciting, flawless day!  Mustapha was our local guide and he was so much fun to  be with! 
 Our second trip was to Grenada/Alhambra with Jonathan as our driver and Edo as our local guide.  I can't say enough
author: Nancy58_13
